title: Iron Stomach
description: Ever wanted to eat a Diamond Sword or a literal Nuclear Reactor? Now you can! Use /eat to turn any item into a snack. High mod compatibility!
body:
**Iron stomach is a lightweight utility mod that adds a single, powerful command: /eat. Tired of carrying actual food? Just grab whatever is in your hand and make it edible!**

## Features:
- Eat almost anything. Works on almost every item in the game, including those from other mods! (mod doesn't work with potions, buckets and bottles)
- Rarity matters. Better items give better nutrition and saturation.
- Universal compatibility. Designed to work with almost any modded item out of the box.
## How to use:
1. Hold any item in your hand
2. type /eat
3. Enjoy your meal!

**Feel free to use this mod in any modpack/server/video but do not re-upload it!**
